title: Canonical completed direct-image tower and limit comparisons
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring with adic datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism. Use completed module direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the strict reduction tower $\mathcal R_X$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-four-towers], and total derived inverse limit [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. Define towerPush as the total right derived functor of termwise ordinary module direct image on strict towers. Define directImageRlimIso by conjugating the identity constant/pullback square through the constant/limit and pullback/direct-image adjunctions. For an object $K$ and $n\ge0$, define towerPushReductionEvaluation by the canonical K-injective tower evaluation, direct image of the normalized reduction evaluation, and the inverse direct-image/coefficient-restriction comparison, in that order. These are fixed maps, without an additional invertibility assertion.
